summary: Sasol Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 15, 2026, covering a period ending the same day. The filing consists primarily of SGML/EDGAR header metadata and a binary graphic file (page_3.jpg) with no substantive textual disclosure regarding a corporate transaction, event, or special situation. As a foreign private issuer's routine current report under the 1934 Act, this 6-K does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It is simply a periodic filing. No deal terms or event-specific details are provided.
